results.name: Finset.card_product
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem card_product (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) : card (s ×ˢ t) = card s * card t :=
  Multiset.card_product _ _

results.name: Finset.filter
results.source_text:
/-- `Finset.filter p s` is the set of elements of `s` that satisfy `p`.

For example, one can use `s.filter (· ∈ t)` to get the intersection of `s` with `t : Set α`
as a `Finset α` (when a `DecidablePred (· ∈ t)` instance is available). -/
def filter (s : Finset α) : Finset α :=
  ⟨_, s.2.filter p⟩

results.name: Finset.card
results.source_text:
/-- `s.card` is the number of elements of `s`, aka its cardinality.

The notation `#s` can be accessed in the `Finset` locale. -/
def card (s : Finset α) : ℕ :=
  Multiset.card s.1
results.docstring:
`s.card` is the number of elements of `s`, aka its cardinality.

The notation `#s` can be accessed in the `Finset` locale.

results.name: Finset.filter_product_card
results.source_text:
theorem filter_product_card (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) (p : α → Prop) (q : β → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q] :
    ((s ×ˢ t).filter fun x : α × β => (p x.1) = (q x.2)).card =
      (s.filter p).card * (t.filter q).card +
        (s.filter (¬ p ·)).card * (t.filter (¬ q ·)).card := by
  classical
  rw [← card_product, ← card_product, ← filter_product, ← filter_product, ← card_union_of_disjoint]
  · apply congr_arg
    grind
  · apply Finset.disjoint_filter_filter'
    exact (disjoint_compl_right.inf_left _).inf_right _

results.name: Fintype.card_prod
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem Fintype.card_prod (α β : Type*) [Fintype α] [Fintype β] :
    Fintype.card (α × β) = Fintype.card α * Fintype.card β :=
  card_product _ _

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
